title: A newer claim about the wrong revision
request: Will my A18 battery and C18-A charger work with this bare drill for furniture? Maximum 700 SEK delivered; I own bits.

evidence.text: Fictional Northbank D18 Revision A manual supports furniture screwdriving with A18 and C18-A. This excerpt makes no statement about Revision B.
Actual readable model label in the supplied image: D18 Rev B. Bare tool for 600.00 SEK delivered; no other fees.
Today the seller says every Northbank 18 V battery fits every D18 revision. They supply no Revision B documentation.

hard_failures.text: Claims compatibility is established from the Revision A manual or newer general seller assurance.

usefulness.text: Names the exact revision gap instead of equating recency with technical authority.
Treats 600.00 SEK as the bare-tool price while a usable setup depends on verifying compatibility.
Requests applicable Revision B evidence or recommends skipping if the match cannot be established.

acceptable_outcomes: Compatibility remains unresolved; a new seller statement does not make the unrelated manual applicable.
